items.name: GestaltX
items.description: An MobileGestalt editor for iOS 27.x, featuring region-code tweaks, device presets, backups.
items.readme:
GestaltX

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.3-blue)](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/iOS-27.x-black?logo=apple)](#compatibility) [![SwiftUI](https://img.shields.io/badge/Swift-SwiftUI-orange?logo=swift)](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPLv3-blue)](LICENSE) [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README_ZH-CN.md) A MobileGestalt editor for iPhone and iPad. Developed by [huamidev](https://github.com/huamidev). ## Features | Category | Presets and tools | | --- | --- | | Display | Dynamic Island capability and layout, Always-On Display, AOD Vibrancy, Liquid Glass low-power rendering | | Device | Model name, boot/shutdown chime, charge limit, tap to wake, Camera Control settings, Action Button settings | | iPad | Apple Pencil settings, Stage Manager capability, iPad app compatibility | | Intelligence | Independent region-code options, Apple Intelligence capability flag, and sales-region options for activation attempts on China-mainland devices | | Advanced | Apple internal feature flags, internal storage view, Security Research Device flag | | Field editor | Read, search, add, edit, and remove `CacheExtra` fields; local plist import/export; String, Integer, Real, Boolean, Data, Date, Array, and Dictionary values | | Changes | Automatic reading and manual re-read, staged before/after review, verified writes, per-preset restore | | Backups | Automatic initial backup before device editing, backup before every write, original-value records; open, export, restore, and delete | | Logs & respring | Actual exploit-stage logs and manual NeoSpring respring | Usually, changing the region code is enough to try enabling AI; there is no need to change Sales Region. Selecting United States for Region Code sets `RegionCode` to `LL` and keeps the sales-region suffix. You can also choose China (Mainland), Hong Kong, Taiwan, Japan or the United Kingdom. Sales Region and Region Code can be applied together: the sales suffix follows Sales Region, while the code follows Region Code. *If you previously changed Sales Region, restore your device’s original sales region and apply it first.* Disabling a preset or using its Revert button restores the recorded original values and types. Keys that were originally absent are removed. If an older change has no original record, use Remove Added Fields only when you know those fields were added. Presets modify capability flags; actual effects depend on the device and OS. China-mainland devices can use the Apple Intelligence and region options to attempt activation; availability also depends on the model, OS version, and Apple services. ## Compatibility Supports **iOS / iPadOS 27.x**. **iOS / iPadOS 26.x is not supported for on-device MobileGestalt access.** Powered by [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query). SystemGroup access requires iOS 27; available features depend on the device and OS. Local plist editing is also supported. Signing requires a certificate and provisioning profile with at least one usable App Group. Sign the app and its embedded share extension with at least one **common App Group**, and keep the extension when re-signing. Both processes detect their actual signed App Groups at runtime. ## Import a plist In Files or another app, select a MobileGestalt plist, tap **Share**, and choose **GestaltX**. The share extension reads the supplied file and hands it to the app through the shared App Group. Return to GestaltX if it does not open automatically. The app checks a device-bound proof from a GestaltX export, or at least two unique identifiers obtained from this device, then asks you to confirm the import. Files that cannot be verified are rejected. Previously imported files are never used as the reference for device identity. Some original plists contain no unique device identifiers. Export a copy from GestaltX on this device first: its verification key stays in the device-only Keychain and is never included in the file. Shared files are checked at launch and on return to the foreground. Pending edits are preserved until you save or discard them. Confirmed imports open as local documents. **MG Control** supports adding, editing, renaming and deleting typed keys and values. Use **Restore Imported Plist** to restore a verified file to this device; restoration requires a matching system cache layout and an additional confirmation, backs up the current file, and verifies the write. Restart the device afterward. ## Language support GestaltX follows your iOS language settings, with English as the default and fallback. Persian includes right-to-left layout support. | Language | Locale | | --- | --- | | English | `en` | | 简体中文 — Simplified Chinese | `zh-Hans` | | 繁體中文（台灣）— Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) | `zh-Hant-TW` | | 繁體中文（香港）— Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong) | `zh-Hant-HK` | | Tiếng Việt — Vietnamese | `vi` | | Русский — Russian | `ru` | | فارسی — Persian | `fa` | ## Credits - [forcequitOS / Taj C — worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query) - [neonmodder123](https://github.com/neonmodder123) - [skadz108](https://github.com/skadz108) - [rooootdev — NeoSpring](https://github.com/rooootdev/neospring) - [Nouvborne — Ketamine](https://github.com/Nouvborne/Ketamine) - [PoomSmart — MGKeys](https://github.com/PoomSmart/MGKeys) - [leminlimez — Nugget](https://github.com/leminlimez/Nugget) - [rooootdev — mond](https://github.com/rooootdev/mond) - [frs0n — GestaltEdit](https://github.com/frs0n/GestaltEdit) ## Disclaimer For security research and educational purposes only. Use only on devices you own or are authorized to manage. Back up your data before making changes. Modifying MobileGestalt may cause system instability or require a device restore. You are responsible for the changes you apply and the resulting risks. ## License [GNU GPL v3](LICENSE) · Copyright © 2026 huamidev.

items.name: S2Arm
items.description: Run your own Switch games natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac: game code rewritten to ARM64, graphics direct to Metal, one app for the whole library. Bring your own games and keys. 把你自己的 Switch 游戏原生带到 iPhone / iPad / Mac。
items.readme:
**Your own Switch games, running natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac.** Game code is rewritten to native ARM64 and runs directly on the device's processor, with graphics going straight to Metal. Your whole library lives in one app, and a few clicks in the Mac or Windows launcher take a game from import to play. Platforms: iPhone / iPad (iOS / iPadOS 18 and later) · Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 15 and later) · Build on Mac or Windows · Android / HarmonyOS coming soon · License: Apache-2.0 · **Bring your own games** [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Download the launcher](https://jhaizhou-ops.github.io/S2Arm/) · [All releases](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/releases) · [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md)

## A native port, not an emulator The game's own ARM64 code is rewritten at build time and then runs directly on the processor in your iPhone, iPad or Mac. There is no CPU emulator in between. Graphics calls are translated straight to Metal, and system services come from a native host. That is where the speed, the low heat and the battery life come from. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#native-port) ## One app, your whole library Every game you import goes into the same S2Arm app; open it and pick what to play. The whole library takes a single App slot on your developer account, so adding a game never means installing another app or spending another signing slot. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#one-app-whole-library) ## Graphical launchers, next to zero setup There is a graphical launcher for Mac and one for Windows. On first launch the welcome page boils everything down to three steps: get this computer ready, add your keys, add your games, with a single primary button at any moment. Everything else is either bundled or fetched in one click, and you never touch a command line. After you click Build, every stage shows its progress, elapsed and remaining time, and disk use. Several games can queue up and build one after another. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#graphical-launchers)

## Let an AI drive Both the Mac and Windows launchers expose a control interface, `s2armctl`. An AI assistant can import games, build, install, follow progress and read errors, and every step shows up in the launcher window. A companion self-check, self-fix and feedback toolkit lets the AI find a problem, apply the documented fix, and, when it cannot, package a diagnostic bundle for you to file. Watch an AI diagnose and fix a real problem end to end: [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#ai-at-the-wheel) ### Have an AI do it for you Send this to your AI assistant (it needs to be able to run commands on your computer): > Please read https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/blob/main/launchers/macos/skill/s2arm-operator/SKILL.md and then help me install my Switch game on my iPhone. It moves forward with a few commands, and you can watch every step in the launcher window: ```bash /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl start # open and connect to the launcher /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl next # what to do now, who does it, and why /Applications/S2Arm.app/Contents/Resources/s2armctl diag export ~/Desktop/S2Arm-diagnostics.zip # export a diagnostic bundle if it cannot fix a problem ``` Anything only you can do (system permission prompts, signing in with your Apple ID, tapping Trust on your phone), the AI stops and asks you to do. On Windows, use `s2armctl.cmd` in the launcher folder with the same commands; exporting a diagnostic bundle is currently Mac-only. ## Tested at scale **211** games surveyed with a **95%** first-try build success rate. **4,700+** test runs on real iOS devices and **1,000+** on macOS. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#tested-at-scale) ## Fast, smooth, and easy on the battery On a 16 GB MacBook Air (M3), from importing a game to a finished iPhone build, completely cold: | Game | Game files | Shaders | Build time | |---|---|---|---| | A 23.5 GB action RPG | 23.5 GB | 1,222 | **6.4 min** | | A 12.0 GB life-sim game | 12.0 GB | 9,315 | **8.6 min** | | A 17.5 GB open-world game | 17.5 GB | 26,999 | **34 min** | A Switch 2 game, measured on an iPhone 17 Pro Max: a **full 60 fps** while the phone is cool, **37–43 fps** once sustained load has heated it up, at about **0.15 J per frame**. [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#speed-and-efficiency) ## Platforms | Platform | Support | |---|---| | iPhone / iPad | iOS / iPadOS 18 and later; every game is chosen inside one app | | Mac | Apple silicon, macOS 15 and later; builds locally and plays games right on the Mac | | Windows | Graphical launcher that builds and installs games for iPhone / iPad | | Android / HarmonyOS | Coming soon | [Evidence](docs/validation/EVIDENCE.md#platforms) ## Getting started 1. Download the Mac or Windows launcher from the [download page](https://jhaizhou-ops.github.io/S2Arm/) and open it. Building for iPhone on a Mac needs the free Xcode from the App Store, signed in with your Apple ID; the launcher walks you through it. 2. Import your own keys and games. Put the base game, updates and DLC in one folder and import them together. 3. Choose iPhone / iPad or this Mac, then click Build. 4. Follow the launcher to sign and install with your own Apple ID (the Windows launcher ships with the Impactor signing tool), open S2Arm, and pick a game from the library. Back up your saves before updating the app. The release uses the new app identifier `io.s2arm.*`, which the system treats as a new app: saves from the beta builds do not carry over automatically. ## Honest boundaries S2Arm runs 64-bit (AArch64) games. Apple silicon cannot execute 32-bit ARM code, so 32-bit games are outside what S2Arm supports, as are games that need a 36-bit address space. ## Development [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [AI collaboration policy](LLM_POLICY.md) · [Diagnosis and root-fix skills for AI](skills/) · [Report a problem](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm/issues) · [Third-party licenses](THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md) ## Thanks S2Arm stands on the shoulders of its community. - **Co-developers**: thank you to everyone who has opened a pull request or issue in this project. Your code, device testing and bug reports shaped S2Arm (in order of first contribution): [@biglawine](https://github.com/biglawine), [@yyan160](https://github.com/yyan160), [@DanielZhangyc](https://github.com/DanielZhangyc), [@vickwv](https://github.com/vickwv), [@Xc1Ym](https://github.com/Xc1Ym), [@fjack](https://github.com/fjack), [@ha7rock](https://github.com/ha7rock), [@yourmoonlight](https://github.com/yourmoonlight), [@qidian99](https://github.com/qidian99), [@n06ody](https://github.com/n06ody), [@YTwsy](https://github.com/YTwsy), [@wdjwxh](https://github.com/wdjwxh), [@realskyrin](https://github.com/realskyrin), [@wwmogu](https://github.com/wwmogu), [@quancunlau](https://github.com/quancunlau), [@moongrant](https://github.com/moongrant), [@imyinyx](https://github.com/imyinyx), [@s-leeq](https://github.com/s-leeq), [@Zhangbu](https://github.com/Zhangbu), [@retX0](https://github.com/retX0), [@zh0ngtian](https://github.com/zh0ngtian), [@fengbird](https://github.com/fengbird), [@zsakvo](https://github.com/zsakvo), [@1500256797](https://github.com/1500256797), [@BossaMelon](https://github.com/BossaMelon), [@GayoZhao](https://github.com/GayoZhao), [@sovaly](https://github.com/sovaly), [@ruterfu](https://github.com/ruterfu), [@fyn1320068837-source](https://github.com/fyn1320068837-source), [@InTheManXG](https://github.com/InTheManXG). - **Ryujinx** (Ryujinx Team and Contributors, MIT): upstream for system services and shader translation; S2Arm's compatibility layer is built on it. - **[NX2Apple](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple)** (LNPANDY, MIT): upstream of the launcher interface. - **[nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative)** (seedds, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 seedds): the original work behind the direct graphics layer that connects game graphics straight to Metal. That generous release is what made the direct path possible. - **[d2r-mobile](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile)** (MIT): pioneered this technical path, bringing your own Switch game natively to iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and HarmonyOS for the first time. - **Impactor** (Samara M, MIT) and **apple-codesign** (MPL-2.0): signing and installing from Windows. - **LNPANDY** and the original authors and contributors of the iOS library shell: the shell and its RomFS archive subsystem. - **ns2pro-bridge** (DanielZhangyc, MIT), **MacNativeGames** (MIT), **LumaDock** (MIT), **deko3d** (fincs, zlib), **nvn.h** (h1k421, MIT), **bcdec** (Sergii Kudlai, MIT / Unlicense), **SPIRV-Cross** and **Vulkan-Headers** (The Khronos Group), **SMAA** (Jorge Jimenez et al., MIT), the **Mesa** tessellator (Microsoft, MIT), **Capstone**, **LZ4**, **.NET**, **libvpx**, **libopus**, **dav1d**, and the **Noto** fonts. Versions, full license texts and what each component does are in [NOTICE](NOTICE) and the [third-party license list](THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md). ## Star History ## License and legal S2Arm is open source under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE). The project ships no games and no keys; obtain your own game files legally. S2Arm is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, and game titles and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

items.name: Erosion-CN
items.description: iOS / iPadOS 系统配置与 MobileGestalt 研究工具箱（简体中文防白苹果安全加固版）
items.readme:
Erosion-CN

基于 worse_query 的 iOS / iPadOS 系统配置与 MobileGestalt 研究工具箱（简体中文防白苹果安全加固版）

支持 iOS / iPadOS 27.0 – 27.2 / 27.3 beta 1（完整支持）以及 iOS / iPadOS 26.x（部分支持）。

--- ## 项目简介与核心改进 **Erosion-CN** 分支衍生自官方上游项目 **[jailbreakdotparty/Erosion](https://github.com/jailbreakdotparty/Erosion)**，完成了 **100% 简体中文界面本地化**，修复了原版多项严重真机 Bug，并进行了系统级防白苹果安全加固与底层能力扩展： 1. **修复重启后修改自动失效还原（反弹回原厂状态）的严重 Bug** - 原版在未手动切换过设置开关时，`mgWriteAtomically` 默认返回 `false`，导致实际走了临时文件替换（`replaceItemAt`），破坏了系统缓存文件的 Inode 与 `_mobilegestalt` POSIX 属主权限，设备一重启即被系统丢弃重建；同时原版在 iOS 27 上额外注入了非缓存键 `RegionInfo`（`zHeENZu+wbg7PUprwNwBWg`），触发开机缓存合法性校验整包重置。 - 本分支已默认强制锁定原位覆盖写入，严格遵循 iOS 27 原厂缓存键结构，并自动匹配写入对应机型的监管型号（`RegulatoryModelNumber`），**真正做到持久化生效、重启不反弹**。 2. **修复内置 Plist 编辑器破坏布尔值与相机浮点参数导致「相机黑屏」的严重 Bug** - 原版 `PlistManager` 将 `CFBoolean`（`` / ``）以及整数值 `Double`（如相机变焦倍率 `1.0`、`2.0`、`5.0` 等）误判转换为了 `` 整型，导致编辑保存 `MobileGestalt` 后系统相机取景直接黑屏。 - 本分支改用 `CFBooleanGetTypeID()` 与 `CFNumberIsFloatType()` 精确识别底层 CoreFoundation 类型，保留原始 Plist 根类型与编码格式，并对未修改项执行 **100% 原样无损直通（Lossless Pass-through）**，彻底解决相机黑屏问题。 3. **零 0 字节窗口原位写入协议（`pwrite` + 按需尾截断 + `F_FULLFSYNC`）** - 重构底层文件 I/O：不再先执行 `ftruncate(fd, 0)` 清空系统文件，而是直接从偏移 `0` 原位覆盖写入、写完后按需裁剪尾部，并调用 `fcntl(fd, F_FULLFSYNC)` 强制刷新 APFS 与物理闪存缓存，断电或异常中断绝不留空文件。 4. **写入前变更对比预览（Diff Preview）+ 写后全量读回校验与自动回滚** - 点击「应用」时逐条展示所有待修改键值与十六进制槽位对比（`修改前 → 修改后`）； - 写入前自动保存 `PreApplyGestalt.plist` 快照，写入后立即从磁盘读回并做二进制 Plist 反序列化与严格类型校验，一旦出现任何不一致立即自动原位回滚。 5. **本机 `libMobileGestalt.dylib` 运行时动态偏移解析（零硬编码）** - 在设备运行时只读扫描内存中加载的 `/usr/lib/libMobileGestalt.dylib` 查询描述符表，实时计算当前机型与当前系统版本的 `CacheUUID`、总槽位数及布尔槽位偏移（`green-tea`、`not-green-tea`、`wapi`）； - **严格多重校验门控**：仅当本机 `CacheUUID` 唯一匹配、总长度精确等于 `槽位数 × 9`、有效位 `validity == 1`、8 字节槽位填充全为 `0` 且无任何无关字节变动时才允许修改；解析未通过时自动锁定开关并拦截写入。 6. **跨机型 / 跨系统升级四重指纹防呆、SHA-256 备份摘要校验与云备份隔离** - 本地备份文件自动标记 `isExcludedFromBackup = true`，防止通过 iCloud / 电脑换机迁移时将旧设备的缓存备份带入新设备； - 生成原始备份 `OriginalGestalt.plist` 时自动计算并持久化记录 `SHA-256` 完整性摘要；还原原始备份时强制核对 `SHA-256`、`CacheVersion`、`CacheUUID`、`CacheData` 长度与本机硬件 `ProductType`，从根源上杜绝跨系统升级或损坏备份覆写导致的基带/eSIM 异常。 7. **重签证书 `App Group` 自动探测与高危软砖项拆除** - 运行时通过 `SecTaskCopyValueForEntitlement` 与纯 Swift Mach-O `LC_CODE_SIGNATURE` 签名段解析自动匹配任意重签工具注入的可用 `group.*` 容器； - 默认移除并拦截上游版本中存在软砖/无限设置向导隐患的高危功能（如 iPhone 正则盲改切片的 iPadOS 模式、个人零售设备的监管模式开关、非缓存键注入等）。 8. **完善机型适配、iOS 27 进阶 AI 能力解锁与实用工具优化** - 补全 iPhone 15 / 16 / 17 / Air / 18 / Duo 全系列及 M 系列 iPad 监管型号映射与硬件特征表，修复原版“80% 充电上限”与“开机提示音”硬件判断互换笔误及自定义键值恒写入 `true` 的 Bug； - **Apple 智能子能力打包与 iOS 27 进阶 AI 解锁（`v0.6.2`）**：「启用 Apple 智能开关」自动联动解锁旧机型缺失的相册「消除」(Clean Up) 与备忘录「手写体合成」能力；新增 **「解锁 iOS 27 进阶 AI 能力」** 合并开关，支持为 iPhone 15 Pro / 16 / 17 等机型一键解锁默认仅在最新代硬件设备树 (`IODeviceTree:/product`) 中开启的**个人实时翻译 (`Personal Translator`)** 与 **iOS 27 音频智能 (`Audio Intelligence`)**（注：**iPhone 18 系列机型硬件底层已默认开启上述能力，无需额外开启，故应用内默认不展示该选项**，国行设备仅需开启「解除地区限制」即可完整激活）； - 新增 iOS 26/27「液态玻璃低功耗渲染（省电模式）」开关与机型外层描述同步； - 修复文件浏览器搜索栏失效与失焦清空问题，采用 `stat()` 动态探测本机实时最大 Inode 基线配合 `pathleak` 加速容器扫描（并为动态壁纸与拨号盘页面加入异步加载进度动画），同时新增核心缓存目录 0 秒一键直达入口； 9. **新增应用存档管理与容器缓存清理模块（`v0.6.0`）** - **应用与游戏存档备份、还原与修改器 (`AppDataBackupView`)**：自动扫描本机第三方应用与单机游戏容器，支持一键将 `Documents` 与 `Library/Preferences` 打包备份为 `.zip`、导出分享、跨重装自动匹配最新容器 UUID 原位还原存档，并支持一键跳入存档目录调用内置无损 Plist/文本编辑器修改； - **容器级缓存扫描与清理 (`CacheCleanerView`)**：专治 iOS「系统数据（其他）」暴涨，按体积排行展示各应用容器的 `Library/Caches` 与 `tmp` 可释放空间，支持单应用或批量一键清理（严格保护 `Documents`、聊天记录数据库与登录态）。 10. **新增真机底层生效核验探针、Apple 智能四要素一键体检、影像/健康硬件槽位解锁与全链路沙盒审计加固（`v0.7.2`）** - **真机 `MobileGestalt` 底层生效核验与动态槽位实时探针 (`MGInspectorView`)**：纯只读调用系统库 `MGCopyAnswer` 实时读取当前真机生效值，并与 `OriginalGestalt.plist` 原厂备份、当前 `CacheData / CacheExtra` 待写配置进行三源同屏对比；同时提供本机全量 `720+` 个二进制 `CacheData` 槽位的动态解析检索与自由键名实时探针； - **Apple 智能 (Apple Intelligence) 激活四要素一键体检面板 (`AppleIntelligenceCheckupCard`)**：实时聚合核验「销售地区 `LL/LL/A`」、「美版监管型号 `Axxxx`（基于真实主板型号防伪装误判）」、「端侧 AI 芯片准入」及「系统实时生效回读」，并在原生 AI 机型上自动锁定 `InternalInstall` 互斥开关，支持一键自动配齐全部缺失项； - items.readme: # Apex Neural Rendering (ANR) [Apex Neural Rendering](https://apexcompute.com/neural-rendering) by [Apex Compute](https://apexcompute.com). - **ANR FG**: frame generation. In beta. - **ANR SR**: super resolution (upscaling). Beta soon. - **ANR RR**: ray reconstruction (denoising for ray tracing). Beta soon. - **Source code**: coming soon. - **nr-record**: records a game's frame generation or upscaler inputs to compare ANR FG, NVIDIA DLSS-G, DLSS, FSR, XeSS and others ([below](#record-and-compare-frame-generation)). Source in this repository. ## ANR FG Beta 1. Download a package from [Releases](../../releases): - `anr-fg-full`: for games without OptiScaler. - `anr-fg-addon`: for games that already use [OptiScaler](https://github.com/optiscaler/OptiScaler). 2. Close the game, extract the package and run the installer with the folder of the game's `.exe`: - Windows: `install.cmd` - Linux and Steam Deck (Proton): `sh install.sh ""`, then set the game's launch options to the line it prints: `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="dxgi=n,b" %command%`, or `winmm=n,b` in Vulkan games 3. In the game, turn on frame generation (the NVIDIA option where the game offers several). To uninstall, run `uninstall.cmd` or `sh uninstall.sh` with the same folder. ## Supported GPUs - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20, 30, 40 and 50 series, and GTX 16 series - AMD Radeon RX 5000, 6000, 7000 and 9000 series, and Steam Deck - Intel Arc A and B series On Windows 10 and 11, and on Linux and SteamOS with Proton. ## Results and problems Please post them as [issues](../../issues/new/choose): - **Performance results**: run the test kit from the release and attach its result file. - **Problems**: the game, GPU and driver, operating system, settings and what you saw, with the newest `nr_fg-*.log` from under the game's `OptiScaler/custom/Apex Neural Rendering FG` folder. OptiScaler is GPL-3.0; its source for each release is attached to the release. ## Record and compare frame generation nr-record records the inputs a game gives its frame generation, losslessly. You can then replay a recording through any frame generation DLL you have (ANR FG, a game's DLSS-G `nvngx_dlssg.dll`) and compare the results as videos or images. nr-record includes no frame generation. Requirements: - a D3D12 or Vulkan game with DLSS frame generation, with the `anr-fg-full` package installed (it includes OptiScaler); - Windows 10 or 11, or Linux with Proton; - [ffmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/download.html) and ffprobe on the `PATH`; - for DLSS-G replays, an NVIDIA RTX 40 or 50 series GPU. 1. **Install.** Download `nr-record-1.1-windows.zip` or `nr-record-1.1-linux.tar.gz` from the [FG-V.B15 release](../../releases/tag/FG-V.B15) and extract it. Close the game and run the installer with the folder of the game's `.exe`: - Windows: `install.cmd ""`. No launch option is needed. - Linux and Steam Deck (Proton): `sh install.sh ""`. Set the game's Steam launch options to `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="dxgi=n,b" %command%` (the ANR FG installer prints the same line). Do not set this on Windows: the game may not start. The installer copies `nr-record` into `OptiScaler/custom/` and sets `FGNvngxReplacement=nr-record` in `OptiScaler.ini` (it keeps the original). When you are not recording, ANR FG generates the frames, or DLSS-G if ANR FG is not installed (`forward` in `nr-record/dlssg/nr_record.ini`). `uninstall.cmd` or `sh uninstall.sh` with the same folder removes nr-record and restores `OptiScaler.ini`. To install by hand: copy `capture/OptiScaler/custom/nr-record` into `OptiScaler/custom/`, set `FGNvngxReplacement=nr-record`, and set `forward` to `..\..\Apex Neural Rendering FG\dlssg\nvngx_dlssg.dll` or `nvidia`. 2. **Record.** Turn on DLSS frame generation in the game. **F6** starts and stops a recording; **F9** records the next 8 frames. Each start and stop beeps. While recording, the game shows only real frames. Recordings go to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\nr-record\` (Windows) or `~/.local/share/nr-record/` (Proton). A frame takes about 26 MB at 3840x2160 and 6 MB at 1806x972. `nr-record/dlssg/nr_record--.log` lists what was recorded. To record the upscaler's inputs instead (super resolution, D3D12 games): open OptiScaler's menu (**Insert**), pick `nr-record` in the upscaler list, and press **F6** to start and stop. It upscales with the upscaler `OptiScaler.ini` names (DLSS on NVIDIA, else FSR, or XeSS) and records that output too. Pick your upscaler again afterwards. Replay these recordings with `--generator dlss`, `fsr` or `xess` ([replay](record/replay/README.md#sr-and-rr)). 3. **Replay.** On Windows, in the package folder (`REC` is a recording's folder): ```bat tools\nr-record.exe info REC tools\nr-replay.exe --record REC --out out\anr --generator provider --dll "\nvngx_dlssg.dll" --label "ANR FG" --stream - | tools\nr-video.exe video - --out out\anr.mp4 tools\nr-replay.exe --record REC --out out\dlssg --generator nvidia --dll "\nvngx_dlssg.dll" --label DLSS-G --stream - | tools\nr-video.exe video - --out out\dlssg.mp4 tools\nr-video.exe project out\anr.mp4 out\dlssg.mp4 --out out\cmp.compare.json --labels "ANR FG" DLSS-G ``` On Linux, one command runs both replays under Proton's Wine and writes both videos, a side-by-side video and the compare project: ```bash python3 tools/nr_replay_wine.py --record REC --out cmp --video \ --generator provider --dll "/nvngx_dlssg.dll" --label "ANR FG" \ --b-generator nvidia --b-dll "/nvngx_dlssg.dll" --b-label DLSS-G ``` For images, replay with `--raw` instead of `--stream` and run `nr-video png`. 4. **Compare.** `viewer/renderer --compare --project cmp/compare.json` (Windows: `viewer\renderer.exe --compare --project out\cmp.compare.json`) plays both videos in sync, with a divider, side by side view, pixel zoom and marks, and exports videos and images. From the command line: `--compare-export PROJECT --out FILE --very-high`. `viewer/renderer --captures` lists your recordings and regenerates their frames with each generator. Docs: [recording](record/README.md), [format](record/FORMAT.md), [replay and videos](record/replay/README.md), [viewer](renderer/README.md). Build: `bazel build //record:nr-record //record/replay:nr-video //renderer`; Windows parts: `bazel build --config=windows_cross //record/capture:package //record/replay:nr-replay`. ## Citation ```bibtex @software{apex_neural_rendering, author = {{Apex Compute}}, title = {Apex Neural Rendering (ANR)}, year = {2026}, url = {https://github.com/apex-compute/ANR}, note = {https://apexcompute.com/neural-rendering} } ```

# chat-demo

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A static chat demo powered by the DeepSeek API. No application backend is required: the browser connects directly to the configured API service.

You can [try the app online](https://deepseek-ai.github.io/chat-demo/) or download the archive from [Releases](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-chat-demo/releases), extract it, and double-click `index.html` to use it locally without installation or a build. Enter your API key in Settings before your first chat.

## Getting started

Install Node.js 22.12+ and pnpm, then run:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/chat-demo.git
cd chat-demo
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

Open http://localhost:8090.

To build the static site:

```sh
pnpm build
```

The output is written to `dist/`. Deploy it to a static web server or open `dist/index.html` directly. Opening the file directly requires browser support for storage on `file://` pages and an API service that permits their cross-origin requests.

## Features

- Multiple conversations with automatic titles, renaming, and deletion; edit prompts, regenerate replies, and switch between message branches.
- Streaming replies, deep thinking, smart search, link reading, and source citations; stop generation or continue eligible replies.
- Upload, paste, or drag and drop attachments; use voice input and read replies aloud. A live audio spectrum appears in the first row of the input area while recording on mobile.
- Markdown, syntax highlighting, KaTeX math, and Mermaid diagrams.
- Simplified Chinese and English, light and dark themes, mobile layouts, location settings, and chat history import and export.

## Data and storage

Your API key and settings are stored in the browser's localStorage. Conversations and original attachments are stored in IndexedDB. Local data is isolated by browser profile and site origin. Sending messages, uploading attachments, and using speech features sends the relevant content to the configured API service.

History import and export in Settings use ZIP archives. After confirmation and successful validation, importing replaces all local conversations and attachments. Exports include conversations and locally available original images, but exclude API keys, settings, and original non-image attachments. See the [history import/export documentation (Chinese)](src/services/chat/history/README.md) for the archive format and preservation details.

Settings → Data → Delete all chats clears all local conversations, original attachments, and unsent drafts after confirmation. It stops ongoing replies and returns to a new chat. Your API key and settings are preserved; files already uploaded to the API service are not deleted.

## Development

| Command       | Description                  |
| ------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `pnpm dev`    | Start the development server |
| `pnpm build`  | Build into `dist/`           |
| `pnpm type`   | Run TypeScript type checks   |
| `pnpm lint`   | Lint with oxlint             |
| `pnpm format` | Format with oxfmt            |

[rspack.config.ts](rspack.config.ts) uses `https://api.deepseek.com` by default. Use `createConfig({ apiOrigin, devServer })` to customize the API origin and development server proxy.

Chat uses `deepseek-flash` by default through Anthropic-compatible Messages / Files APIs. Speech features use ASR / TTS endpoints. Requests include extensions for search, link reading, titles, and `latest_reminder`, so the configured service must support the corresponding capabilities. Supported attachment formats are determined by server-side validation.

```text
src/
  app/                 Application layout, themes, and global styles
  components/          Chat, settings, Markdown, and other UI components
  i18n/                English and Chinese translations
  services/
    api/               API requests, SSE, and protocol types
    chat/              Conversations, message branches, storage, and history import/export
    markdown/          Markdown parsing, syntax highlighting, and diagrams
    speech/            Audio recording and read-aloud playback
  utils/               Shared utilities
```

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). The build copies the license to `dist/LICENSE`; include it when distributing the app. Third-party dependencies are subject to their own licenses.

# SuperMimic

[Project page](https://supermimic.github.io) | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28480)

SuperMimic trains a humanoid whole-body motion tracker with one differentiable world model, built on [mjlab](https://github.com/mujocolab/mjlab).

## Setup

Install [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

```bash
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
```

Clone both repos as siblings:

```bash
mkdir supermimic_ws && cd supermimic_ws
git clone git@github.com:HybridRobotics/supermimic.git
git clone git@github.com:HybridRobotics/mjlab_research.git
cd supermimic
```

## Usage

Available task IDs:

- `SuperMimic-GenCoord-G1` — generalized coordinates representation
- `SuperMimic-MaxCoord-G1` — maximal coordinates representation

Train a world model and policy:

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<GPU_ID> uv run src/supermimic/scripts/train.py \
  <TASK_ID> --runner.run_name <description>
```

Play back a trained model:

```bash
uv run src/supermimic/scripts/play.py \
  <TASK_ID> --wandb-path <RUN_PATH>
```

## Acknowledgements

SuperMimic contains code inspired by these projects:

- [ControlVAE](https://github.com/heyuanYao-pku/Control-VAE) (BSD-3-Clause)
- [robotic_world_model](https://github.com/leggedrobotics/robotic_world_model) (Apache-2.0)
- [DreamerV3](https://github.com/danijar/dreamerv3) (MIT)

## License

Copyright 2026 The SuperMimic Authors.

Released under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE).

Private AI meeting notes. Free and open source.

Download for Mac · Windows · Linux

Yogurt records your calls without adding a bot to the meeting.

macOS 14.4+ (Apple Silicon) · Windows 10 2004+ (x64) · Ubuntu 22.04+ or similar (x64 AppImage) · 8 GB memory

yogurt.so · Help · Build and run locally · MIT license

Made by Frigade.

## What it does - **Live transcripts.** Yogurt records calls and turns speech into text as you talk. - **Meeting summaries.** Yogurt writes up the conversation and any notes you add. - **Private by default.** Your audio, transcripts and AI processing stay on your computer. - **Free and open source.** You can use Yogurt without an account. - **Who said what.** Yogurt names speakers from Zoom, Teams and Meet on Mac only. - **Languages.** Multi-language mode transcribes 99 languages. - **Recording reminders.** Yogurt offers to record when a supported call starts. - **Answers with sources.** Yogurt answers questions across meetings and links to the source. - **Folders and search.** You can find meetings by folder, title, notes or transcript. - **Copy and export.** You can copy notes or transcripts, or save both as Markdown. - **Local MCP server.** Your chosen assistant app can read your notes when you allow access. - **Automatic stop.** Yogurt stops recording when the call ends. ## Watch the demo https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/da16b894-beb1-491a-89e1-fd10666dc9b8 ## How it works 1. **Record.** Start recording your microphone and call audio; you can add your own notes. 2. **Transcribe.** Yogurt uses whisper.cpp and, on supported Macs, Apple SpeechAnalyzer. 3. **Summarize and ask.** A local open-weight model runs through llama.cpp. Meeting data stays local; Yogurt goes online for model downloads and update checks.
Where your meetings, recordings, settings and models are stored - Mac uses `~/Library/Application Support/Yogurt`. - Windows uses `%APPDATA%\Yogurt`. - Linux uses `~/.config/Yogurt`, or `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Yogurt` if set.
## FAQ
What kind of computer do I need?
> A Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 14.4 or newer, a 64-bit PC with Windows 10 (version 2004) or newer, or a 64-bit Linux computer with Ubuntu 22.04 or newer. Each needs at least 8 GB of memory. If your computer is too slow, Yogurt tells you during setup. Calendar and speaker names from calls are Mac only for now.
Windows says “Windows protected your PC.” What do I do?
> Click More info, then Run anyway. Windows shows this for new apps that aren’t signed with a Microsoft certificate yet. Yogurt is open source, so anyone can check what it does.
Does Yogurt join my meetings?
> No. Yogurt records your microphone and the sound playing on your computer. No bot joins the call, so let the other people on the call know you’re recording.
Are recordings saved?
> Yes. Your recordings, transcripts, and notes are saved locally on your computer.
Is Yogurt free?
> Yes. Yogurt is free and open source under the MIT license. No account is needed.
Does Yogurt work offline?
> Yes. After a one-time download of the AI models, transcription and summaries run locally on your computer.
How much does setup download?
> It depends on your computer. Yogurt downloads a smaller notes model first, about 5 GB, then the best one your computer can run well, which can be 14 GB or more. Recording works once setup finishes, and notes and questions work offline once the notes model is in.
How do I connect my assistant app?
> In **Settings → AI apps**, turn on access, copy the helper command, and add it as a local MCP server in your assistant app. Access is off by default. The app can read your meetings, notes and transcripts, but cannot change them. It may send what it reads to its own online model. Turn access off in Yogurt to stop further reads.
Can other apps read my notes through MCP?
> Access is off until you enable it in **Settings → AI apps**. Apps get read-only access to meetings, notes and transcripts. Mac and Linux use a socket in your profile folder with `0600` permissions, so only your user account can open it. Windows uses a named pipe with a new random name each launch, stored only in your profile folder. There is no per-app token, so any app running under your account can read while access is on. Settings shows connected apps by their self-reported names.
Which AI models does Yogurt use?
> Transcription uses Whisper through whisper.cpp, with large-v3-turbo or a smaller model depending on your computer. On supported Macs, Apple SpeechAnalyzer supplies live words while Whisper produces the saved transcript. Summaries and answers use a local open-weight model from the Gemma 4, gpt-oss or Qwen3 families, chosen for your hardware and run through llama.cpp. The app uses Electron and needs no account.
Which languages does Yogurt support?
> Pick **Multi-language** in **Settings → Language → Spoken language** to transcribe 99 languages. You can also switch from the **English** menu in a note’s footer before or during recording. English only is the default. Summaries follow the meeting’s main language; answers follow your question’s language. Settings also offers 32 app languages.
Which call apps does Yogurt work with?
> You can record calls in any app because Yogurt captures your microphone and system audio. Call detection covers Zoom, Teams and Meet. On Mac, Yogurt can also read their speaker names with Accessibility permission, when the call app shows who is speaking.
How does Yogurt know a call has started?
> It checks which apps are using your microphone. For browser calls, it also checks the tab title or a nearby calendar event with a call link. This triggers an offer to record; recording starts only when you choose to.
How do I connect my calendar?
> On Mac, allow Calendar access in Settings. Yogurt reads the calendars already on your computer and lets you choose which ones to show. You do not sign into a calendar account in Yogurt.

agentes.chat

The open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents work together.

Website · Cloud · Self-hosting · Features · Discussions

Agents join your channels and DMs with a role, an owner and a budget, work where everyone can see, and ask before anything sensitive. They think with Claude, ChatGPT and Codex, Gemini, Grok or any OpenRouter model, use MCP tools, and get a computer and a browser of their own. Self-hosting is free and always will be (AGPL-3.0, no license key, no paid tier), or use agentes.chat Cloud, the paid, hosted option: both run this same codebase. ## Why agentes.chat - **One conversation for people and agents.** Agents are members of the workspace, not a sidebar bot: they read the channel, answer when it's theirs to answer, and hand work back and forth. - **Safe by default.** Merges, deploys and anything a connector marks sensitive wait for a person's approval in the chat. Every model call is budgeted and recorded per agent. - **Agents that actually do the work.** Their own computer, a real browser you can watch and take over, Claude Code and Codex, routines on a schedule or an event, memory that learns. - **Yours to run.** One command on a Linux server, Postgres as the only dependency, web, desktop and phone apps that connect to your server. An open-source alternative to team chat with bolted-on AI bots, and to single-player agent apps such as Grok Bot, ChatGPT dots, OpenBot.run and OpenMausBot (all of which it imports from). ## Quick start - **Cloud:** sign up at [agentes.chat](https://agentes.chat). - **Your own server** (Linux): ```sh curl -fsSL https://agentes.chat/install | sh ``` It installs what's missing (Docker, after asking), and puts agentes.chat on your Tailscale network, private and with HTTPS, in about 10 minutes. [SELF_HOSTING.md](SELF_HOSTING.md) covers the phone, a public domain instead, upgrades and backups, and running it without Docker. Each organization adds its own model key (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Z.ai, MiniMax or OpenRouter) in the app. ## Features | Feature | Status | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | Channels, threads and DMs | ✅ | Public and private channels, DMs with people and agents, and threads started from a message or a stretch of conversation, then followed, closed and archived. | | Agents | ✅ | Each has a role, instructions, a model (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Z.ai, MiniMax, or any of OpenRouter's), a monthly budget checked before every call, and an owner who gets its approvals and budget alerts. | | Router | ✅ | A message nobody @mentioned goes to the router. Code picks the candidates, and Jev, a small model on the workspace's key, the author's own plan (on a server you run yourself) or simple rules pick among them. Up to four agents answer, or none, and the message says who picked. It never grants a permission. | | Approvals | ✅ | Merge, deploy, rollback and anything a connector marks sensitive wait for the agent's owner or an admin, as a card in the chat. The approved action runs once, exactly as approved. | | Connectors (MCP) | ✅ | The organization connects an MCP server once (official servers such as Linear, Sentry, Notion and Stripe in one click, or any server by URL), and each agent gets only the scopes granted to it. With a Composio key, Google Drive, Calendar, Sheets and Docs, Slack, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zendesk, Asana, Figma, Intercom, Dropbox, Square, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, Pinterest, Reddit and WhatsApp Business connect through Composio. | | Skills | ✅ | Markdown skills (`SKILL.md`) from a zip, a GitHub link or the editor, with versions. Agents load one when a task needs it. | | Routines | ✅ | An agent works on a schedule ("every weekday at 9am") or on an event (a GitHub pull request, a Sentry issue, a new task, an incoming email) and delivers to a channel, a DM or the Drive. | | Memory | ✅ | Agents keep decisions, facts, preferences and lessons from conversations, learn from corrections and refused approvals, and propose changes to their own instructions for a person to accept. | | Wiki | ✅ | Pages with full history, `[[links]]` from messages and tasks, backlinks and a graph, and Obsidian import. Agents read it, and write only when a person asks. | | Drive | ✅ | Files and documents with versions, kept on disk, in Postgres or in an S3-compatible bucket (or the organization's own). Documents export to Word and PDF. | | Tasks | ✅ | A board with your own columns. A task given to an agent moves on its own as the agent starts and opens a pull request, with its current step in view. | | Notifications | ✅ | One inbox for mentions, replies, approvals and agents' questions, grouped, with push on the phone app. | | Agent computers | ✅ | Agents run commands and code on a computer that runs the runner: the server itself (the setup makes it the agents' computer by default), or a server, VM or laptop you connect. On agentes.chat Cloud, each workspace gets a computer of its own. | | Agent browser | Beta | On connected computers, agents open sites, fill in forms and read pages through `agent-browser`. Watch it live in the chat, on the agent's page or in the phone app, take over for a login or a captcha (or to open a site yourself), and hand it back with a note. | | Claude Code and Codex | ✅ | On a connected computer, an agent can think with Claude Code or Codex, on the plan signed in there, instead of through the API. Codex is still in testing. | | Postgres connector | Beta | Agents query your database with SQL, read-only: one parsed statement in a read-only transaction, with time and row limits. | | Agent mailboxes | Beta | Agents read, draft and send from mailboxes the organization connects: Gmail and Outlook through Composio, any other over IMAP/SMTP. Sending asks for approval by default. | | Phone app | Beta | iPhone and Android (Expo), on agentes.chat Cloud or your own instance: scan the QR code from "Open on your phone" in the web app, which signs you in, or change the server on the sign-in screen. | | Desktop app (macOS; Windows and Linux on x64 and ARM64) | Beta | agentes.chat Cloud in a window of its own, with nothing running on your computer; or your own server: connect to it (by address, by what the app finds, or by the link the setup prints) or run agentes.chat on this computer with no Docker (Mac and Linux). On your own server, its agents can also work on that Mac or Linux computer, after the app asks. Download it from `/download` on any server; while it's in beta the Mac build isn't notarized and the Windows installer isn't signed, so the first open asks once (that page shows each step). | | Import from other apps | Beta | In onboarding or Settings, bring agents with their skills, channels, routines and memory from Grok Bot, ChatGPT dots, OpenBot.run, OpenMausBot, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Paperclip or another agentes.chat workspace. Grok Bot, ChatGPT dots and any other app answer an export prompt. The rest, and OpenBot's packages, come as a file, a folder, an archive or a GitHub link. A preview comes first: skills arrive on, routines active, and keys never. A workspace exports as one file. | | 14 languages | ✅ | The whole app in English, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Indonesian. | | Self-host (Docker) | ✅ | One command (`curl -fsSL https://agentes.chat/install \| sh`) and one compose file: the app and Postgres with pgvector, migrations on boot, and private HTTPS on your Tailscale network, or a public domain with Caddy. | | Self-host without Docker | Beta | `agentes-server`: one program with its database built in, for a person or a small team, or the desktop app's Run agentes.chat on this computer. | ## Contributing Bug reports, ideas and pull requests are welcome. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) explains how to run it from source and the checks a change needs. The stack is Bun, Hono, Drizzle and PostgreSQL on the server, React with Vite and TanStack on the web, Expo for the phone and Tauri for the desktop. Architecture decisions are in [docs/adr](docs/adr). ## License agentes.chat is licensed under the [GNU AGPL-3.0-only](LICENSE). [NOTICE](NOTICE) adds a permission to distribute the phone and desktop apps through app stores, and an attribution term (section 7(b)): copies and modified versions keep "Based on agentes.chat by Codari Global, LLC" in their About screen. The setup CLI in `packages/setup` (`@agenteschat/setup`) is MIT. Contributions come in under the same terms, with nothing to sign. Third-party notices are in [NOTICE](NOTICE) too. The agentes.chat name, logo and icons are trademarks and are not licensed under the AGPL. See [TRADEMARKS.md](TRADEMARKS.md). ## Community Questions, ideas and roadmap talk live in the [Discussions](https://github.com/agentes-chat/agentes-chat/discussions). Bugs and feature requests go in [issues](https://github.com/agentes-chat/agentes-chat/issues), and security reports through [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). items.readme:
English · Español · Français · Italiano · 简体中文 · 한국어 · 日本語 · हिन्दी · العربية · Русский · More languages

  

> [!NOTE] > **HolyArrs 1.1.2: Knaben, TorrentsCSV, SubsPlease and IPTorrents built in**, no Prowlarr needed. Ask for shows in 4K, and Profilarr can send its formats and profiles. [See what's new](https://holyarrs.com/whats-new/) > Every poster, trailer and score in your HolyArrs comes from a server I run and pay for myself, so it stays free for everyone. If HolyArrs made movie night a little better, a sponsor keeps the lights on for all of us 💛 > > > [!TIP] > Be with us! > > | | | > |:--|:--| > | | Get help fast and hang out on [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/mthsvesKpC) | > | | Share ideas and vote on [r/HolyArrs](https://reddit.com/r/HolyArrs) | > | | Sneak peeks on [X](https://x.com/CoderLuii) | > | | More projects on [GitHub](https://github.com/CoderLuii) |

Six apps to watch a show. Now it's one.

HolyArrs is one self-hosted app for your shows, movies and music.
Browse like a streaming app, ask for what you want, and it handles the rest.

About 16.9 MB to download · about 95 MiB of RAM idle on a fresh install · amd64, arm64, armv7
The six apps it replaces download 718.2 MB together.

Quick start · Why · What it does · Moving from other apps · The manual · Help

## 🚀 Running in two minutes Save this as `docker-compose.yml` in a new folder on a local disk: ```yaml name: holyarrs services: holyarrs: image: holyarrs/holyarrs:latest container_name: holyarrs environment: - PUID=1000 - PGID=1000 - TZ=America/New_York volumes: - /your/local/path:/config - /path/to/movies:/movies #optional - /path/to/tv:/tv #optional - /path/to/music:/music #optional - /path/to/downloads:/downloads #optional ports: - 6262:6262 restart: unless-stopped ``` ```sh docker compose up -d ``` Open `http://your-server:6262` and make the owner account. A short setup walks you through folders, a downloader and a Source. No API keys to hunt down. No second container. Every setting is explained in [the manual](#manual) further down. ## 💡 Why I built it A normal media server runs six apps: Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Bazarr, Prowlarr and Seerr. That's six logins, six ports, six update cycles and six API keys to copy between them. When a show doesn't land, you check six places to find out why. I wanted one app. One login, one port, one place to look. So I built it. | App | Download (amd64) | Idle RAM | Logins | Web ports | |---|---|---|---|---| | Sonarr | 87.9 MB | | 1 | 1 | | Radarr | 91.0 MB | | 1 | 1 | | Lidarr | 121.3 MB | | 1 | 1 | | Prowlarr | 80.8 MB | | 1 | 1 | | Bazarr | 156.4 MB | | 1 | 1 | | Overseerr | 180.8 MB | | 1 | 1 | | **Six together** | **718.2 MB** | | **6** | **6** | | **HolyArrs** | **16.9 MB** | **~140 MiB** | **1** | **1 (6262)** | About 43 times smaller. Compressed registry download, linuxserver.io images, amd64, measured 2026-11-08 (HolyArrs size measured on 1.1.2, 2026-11-13). Idle RAM measured 2026-11-08 with 10,000 titles and 55,000 movies and episodes. ## 🎬 Ask for a title, and it shows up in your library Someone asks for a title. HolyArrs searches your Sources, picks the best release with your Pick rules, sends it to your downloader and files it in your library. Your media server hears about it when it lands. | | | |---|---| | 🍿 **Explore** | Browse like a streaming app. Hover a title and the trailer plays. | | 🙋 **Requests** | A whole show or one season. You approve, or let trusted people skip the queue. Plex and Pulsarr watchlists can become requests. | | 🎯 **Pick rules** | You decide which release wins: size, quality, language. | | 💬 **Subtitles** | In the languages you pick, found on subtitle sites and kept with the file. | | 📅 **Calendar** | What's airing next for everything you follow. | | 🔔 **Alerts** | Discord, email, Telegram, ntfy, Gotify, Pushover or a webhook. | | 🚚 **Import your setup** | From Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr, Seerr, Overseerr, qBittorrent and SABnzbd. Pick what comes over, undo it later. | | 🔌 **Old-app API** | Seerr, Prowlarr, Bazarr, Unpackerr and Homepage keep working once you turn it on. | | 🗝️ **No API keys needed** | Titles, artwork and charts come from the HolyArrs metadata server. Your own keys or server work too. | | 🔒 **Encrypted keys** | Stored passwords and keys are locked with a master key that lives in your config folder. | | 🪶 **Tiny** | An image of about 16.9 MB with nothing but HolyArrs inside. |
See every page in motion

Home · Everything waiting on you, at a glance.
Title page · Trailer, cast and one button to ask.

Requests · Approve what friends and family ask for.
Downloads · Every grab, live, in one table.
## 🤝 It works with what you already run - **Downloaders:** qBittorrent, Transmission, Deluge, rTorrent, aria2, SABnzbd, NZBGet - **Media servers:** Plex, Jellyfin, Emby - **Sources:** any Torznab or Newznab indexer, or Prowlarr or Jackett - **Imports your setup from:** Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr, Seerr, Overseerr, qBittorrent, SABnzbd ## 🚚 Bring your old setup with you Open **Settings > Import from other apps**, add each old app's address and API key (or a backup zip), pick what comes over, then select **Import**. You can undo an import later. | From | What comes over | |---|---| | Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr | Library folders, titles, quality profiles as Pick rules, exclusions, naming, indexers and download clients | | Prowlarr | Indexers as Sources | | Bazarr | Default subtitle languages | | Seerr, Overseerr | People and their waiting or approved requests | | qBittorrent, SABnzbd | Downloaders | HolyArrs only reads your old apps and changes nothing in them, so you can run both side by side until you trust it. Keys and passwords stay behind; you type them in again or import them from a file. Custom formats, tags and history don't come over. Media files never move. Step by step: [Import from other apps](https://docs.HolyArrs.com/migrate/). ## 🧭 What it doesn't do yet - **Downloading by itself.** HolyArrs connects to qBittorrent, SABnzbd and the others. It doesn't replace them. - **Phone and TV apps.** Not built. The web app works on a phone. - **Music in Explore** is still being built. What's next is on the [roadmap](https://holyarrs.com/roadmap/). You vote, I build. Post ideas on [r/HolyArrs](https://reddit.com/r/HolyArrs). ## ❓ Questions people ask first **Do I keep qBittorrent or SABnzbd?** Yes, for now. HolyArrs connects to the downloader you already run. A built-in downloader is planned for a later release. **Can Sonarr and Radarr keep running while I try it?** Yes. HolyArrs reads them once and never changes them. **Is it free?** Yes. It's free and open source. --- # 📖 The manual Everything below is reference. The full guides live at [docs.HolyArrs.com](https://docs.HolyArrs.com). ## Supported architectures Pulling `holyarrs/holyarrs:latest` gets the right image for your machine. | Architecture | Available | Runs on | | :----: | :----: | --- | | amd64 | ✅ | Most PCs, servers and NAS boxes | | arm64 | ✅ | Apple silicon, newer Raspberry Pis, ARM servers | | armv7 | ✅ | Older 32-bit ARM boards | On a NAS? See [Unraid, Synology and other NAS boxes](https://docs.HolyArrs.com/run/platforms/). Prefer a native package? An experimental Synology package (`.spk`) is attached to each [release](https://github.com/HolyArrs/HolyArrs/releases). See [Synology package](docs/run/synology.md). ## Version tags Images live on Docker Hub as [`holyarrs/holyarrs`](https://hub.docker.com/r/holyarrs/holyarrs). | Tag | Use it for | | :----: | --- | | `latest` | The newest release. | | `1.1.2` | One exact version. It never moves. | ## Usage ### docker compose (recommended) ```yaml name: holyarrs services: holyarrs: image: holyarrs/holyarrs:latest container_name: holyarrs environment: - PUID=1000 - PGID=1000 - TZ=America/New_York volumes: - /your/local/path:/config - /path/to/movies:/movies #optional - /path/to/tv:/tv #optional - /path/to/music:/music #optional - /path/to/downloads:/downloads #optional ports: - 6262:6262 restart: unless-stopped ``` ### docker cli ```sh docker run -d \ --name=holyarrs \ -e PUID=1000 \ -e PGID=1000 \ -e TZ=America/New_York \ -p 6262:6262 \ -v /your/local/path:/config \ -v /path/to/movies:/movies `#optional` \ -v /path/to/tv:/tv `#optional` \ -v /path/to/music:/music `#optional` \ -v /path/to/downloads:/downloads `#optional` \ --restart unless-stopped \ holyarrs/holyarrs:latest ``` Container settings go in compose. Everything else is set in the app. ## Parameters Each one is written `:`. Change the left side only. | Parameter | Function | | :----: | --- | | `-p 6262:6262` | The web app. | | `-e PUID=1000` | The user HolyArrs runs as. See [User and group](#user-and-group). | | `-e PGID=1000` | The group HolyArrs runs as. | | `-e TZ=America/New_York` | Your time zone, for the calendar, schedules and logs. `Etc/UTC` when left out. | | `-e UMASK=022` | Optional. Permission bits new files leave out. Use `002` when a group must write too. | | `-v /config` | Databases, settings, the master key, backups and logs. Local disk only, never a network share. | | `-v /movies` | Optional. A movie Library folder. | | `-v /tv` | Optional. A shows Library folder. | | `-v /music` | Optional. A music Library folder. | | `-v /downloads` | Optional. Your downloader's download folder. | | `--read-only=true` | Optional. Only `/config` and `/tmp` need to be writable. | | `--user=1000:1000` | Optional. Start as a fixed user. `PUID` and `PGID` are then ignored. | More variables (reverse proxy, URL base, save path): [Environment variables](https://docs.HolyArrs.com/reference/env-vars/). ### Environment variables from files Put `FILE__` in front of any variable to read its value from a file, such as a Docker secret: ```yaml environment: - FILE__HOLYARRS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=/run/secrets/holyarrs_hosts ``` ## User and group `PUID` and `PGID` must match the user that owns your media folders. Find them with: ```sh id youruser # uid=1000(youruser) gid=1000(youruser) ``` HolyArrs never changes the owner of your media or download folders. Give that user write access to them, because HolyArrs makes folders and moves files. ## Application setup Open `http://your-server:6262` and make the owner account right away. There is no default password. Until you make it, whoever opens HolyArrs first becomes the owner. The setup that opens next asks for your folders, a downloader and a Source. Guide: [First run](https://docs.HolyArrs.com/start/first-run/). ### Media folders The four optional mounts are the easy way to start. The cost: each mount is its own filesystem inside the container, so every import is a full copy. Want instant moves that take no extra space? Mount one parent folder with downloads and Library folders inside it, and give your downloader the same mount at the same path. Guide: [Folders](https://docs.HolyArrs.com/start/folders/). ### Docker Desktop on Windows and Mac Use a named volume for `/config`. Media folders can stay host folders. Guide: [Install](https://docs.HolyArrs.com/start/install/). ## Keep your master key safe `holyarrs.key` in your config folder is what opens your stored passwords and keys. Backups don't include it, so keep a copy somewhere else. As the owner, open **Settings > Backups** and choose **Download key kit**. See [Backups](https://docs.HolyArrs.com/run/backups/). ## Updating ```sh docker compose pull docker compose up -d ``` If the new version changes how data is stored, HolyArrs makes a backup first. To go back to it: `docker exec holyarrs /holyarrs restore --pre-update`, then `docker restart holyarrs`. Never remove `/config` during an update. See [Updates](https://docs.HolyArrs.com/run/updates/). ## Security - The owner account is made at first visit. There is no default password. - Stored passwords and keys are encrypted with `holyarrs.key`. - The image has no shell inside it. - Don't forward port 6262 on your router. Use a VPN such as Tailscale, or a reverse proxy with HTTPS. - Report security problems privately: [SECURITY](.github/SECURITY.md). ## Support info The image has no shell, so `docker exec -it holyarrs /bin/bash` won't work. HolyArrs' own commands do: - Follow the log: ```sh docker logs -f holyarrs ``` - Check your setup. Every line says `OK`, `WARN` or `FAIL`, and each `WARN` or `FAIL` says how to fix it: ```sh docker exec holyarrs /holyarrs doctor ``` - Locked out of the owner account: ```sh docker exec -i holyarrs /holyarrs reset-owner ``` - Version number: ```sh docker inspect --format '{{ index .Config.Labels "org.opencontainers.image.version" }}' holyarrs ``` ## Troubleshooting | You see | Do this | | --- | --- | | Permission denied on media folders | `PUID` and `PGID` don't match the owner of those folders. Run `id youruser`, put those numbers in compose and recreate the container. | | Errors with the config folder on a network share | The database needs a local disk. Move `/config` to a local path. Media folders on a share are fine. | | Port 6262 is already in use | Change the left side only, for example `6263:6262`, and open `http://your-server:6263`. | | HolyArrs can't reach qBittorrent or SABnzbd | Inside a container, `localhost` means the container itself. Use the downloader's container name on the same Docker network, or the host's IP address. | | Imports are copied | Mount one shared parent folder. See [Media folders](#media-folders). | More: [Troubleshooting](https://docs.HolyArrs.com/help/troubleshooting/). ## Where to ask | You have | Go to | | --- | --- | | A question | [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/mthsvesKpC) | | An idea or a vote | [r/HolyArrs](https://reddit.com/r/HolyArrs) and the [roadmap](https://holyarrs.com/roadmap/) | | A bug | [Issues](https://github.com/HolyArrs/HolyArrs/issues) (bugs and roadmap only) | | A security problem | [SECURITY](.github/SECURITY.md) | | Anything else | support@HolyArrs.com | ## Contributing Read [CONTRIBUTING](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md), then [Architecture](docs/dev/architecture.md) and [Setup](docs/dev/setup.md). Open an issue before a big change. On your first pull request a bot asks you to accept a short licence agreement ([CLA.md](.github/CLA.md)). One click, once. ## Licence HolyArrs is free and open source under the [GNU AGPL-3.0](LICENSE). Want to build it into a closed product? Email support@HolyArrs.com for a commercial licence. ## Keep it going HolyArrs is free, but it isn't free to run. By default, each install talks to a metadata server I pay for every month. Sponsors cover that, and buy more hours for the things you vote for.

 

---

Built by CoderLuii.
If HolyArrs saves you from running six apps, a star helps other people find it.

items.readme:
# FFmpeg-GUI-Editor-Windows — Ready-to-Use Free Portable Video Editor (.exe)

**FFmpeg-GUI-Editor-Windows** is a lightweight, fast, and **free open-source video editor for Windows 10 and Windows 11** that works as an intuitive graphical user interface (**FFmpeg GUI**). Built specifically for users who want to **download a ready-to-use `.exe` executable** to trim, crop, compress, and convert videos without touching the command line.

No installation, no Python setup, no manual `PATH` configuration, and no watermarks. Just download the release files, place them in the same folder, and start editing. Licensed under **GPL v3**.

---

### 📥 Direct Download & Important Setup Instructions (`.exe` + `libvlc.dll`)
The release package consists of **two required files**: the main executable (`.exe`) and the media engine library (**`libvlc.dll`**).

1. Open the **[Releases](../../releases)** page of this repository.
2. Download **both files** from the latest release:
   * **`FFmpeg-GUI-Editor.exe`** (the main application)
   * **`libvlc.dll`** (required core video playback & rendering library)
3. **Important:** Place both files inside the **same folder** on your PC or USB drive (do not separate them).
4. Double-click the **`.exe`** file to launch the editor immediately — no installation required.

> **⚠️ Note:** Both the `.exe` file and `libvlc.dll` must remain in the exact same directory for the program to start and preview videos properly.

---

### 🖼️ Interface & Quick Visual Guide
![FFmpeg-GUI-Editor-Windows Visual Guide](blob/main/guide.png)



---

### 🌍 Multi-Language Interface (6 Languages Built-In)
Switch between 6 languages directly in the interface without downloading extra language packs:
* 🇬🇧 **English**
* 🇷🇺 **Русский** (Russian)
* 🇨🇳 **中文** (Chinese)
* 🇩🇪 **Deutsch** (German)
* 🇫🇷 **Français** (French)
* 🇮🇹 **Italiano** (Italiano)

---

### 🎬 Core Video Editing Features
* **Lossless Video Trimmer & Cutter:** Cut and trim video start/end points with frame-level precision without re-encoding.
* **Smart Video Crop Tool:** Manual crop selection or automatic black-bar removal (**auto-crop**).
* **Video Compressor & Resizer:** Downscale 4K, 1440p, 1080p, or 720p videos to shrink file sizes for Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, and web upload.
* **Universal Video & Audio Converter:** Convert media files between **MP4, MKV, WebM, AVI, MOV, GIF, APNG, MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG**, and more.
* **Rotate & Flip Video:** Fix vertical or upside-down videos in a single click.
* **Audio Volume Booster & Remover:** Increase/decrease volume or strip audio tracks from video files completely.
* **Duplicate Frame Remover:** Automatically detect and delete frozen or duplicate frames to reduce output file size.
* **Playback Speed & FPS Changer:** Speed up, slow down, or change video frame rate (FPS) effortlessly.
* **Chroma Key (Green Screen Removal):** Remove solid background colors from videos and images.

### ⚙️ Advanced Automation & FFmpeg Tools
* **Duplicate Scene Finder:** Scan and remove repeated video segments across multiple files.
* **Image Sequence to Video / GIF:** Turn a folder of PNG or JPG images into an MP4 video or animated GIF.
* **Built-in Subtitle Editor:** Create, edit, and sync `.srt` subtitles visually on the timeline.
* **Visual FFmpeg Command Generator:** Configure settings via GUI and copy the exact FFmpeg CLI arguments for your own scripts.
* **Batch Video Processing (`.bat`):** Export batch scripts to process dozens of videos via simple drag-and-drop.
* **Frame Extractor & Alpha Blend:** Save individual video frames as images or blend multiple frames together.

---
